title: South Side Marina
gap: No pricing or rental offerings stated
blurb: South Side Marina offers boat docking with state-of-the-art electric and water hook-ups, gated parking, elevator access, restroom and shower facilities, and a pump-out station. It is located near South Side Works, providing easy access to bike trails, walking paths, restaurants, night clubs, retail shopping, a movie theater, galleries, and a fitness center. Full service is provided through Fox Chapel Marine.
